monitor.label: Monitor
monitor.description: Substring of the DDC model name to select the monitor (leave empty for the first Dell found)

update_interval.label: Update Interval
update_interval.description: How often to poll the monitor's DDC state, in milliseconds

kvm_switch.label: KVM USB Switch
kvm_switch.description: Show the experimental KVM USB switch in PIP/PBP mode

panel.title: Dell Display
panel.no_monitor: No Dell monitor detected over DDC/CI. Check the cable and the monitor setting.
panel.no_ddcutil: ddcutil is not installed. Install it to control the display.
panel.no_backend: The plugin's backend script is missing.
panel.mode_help: Picture mode for the main image
panel.input_help: Video input the display is showing
panel.input_confirm: Switch input to {label}? The current picture will be lost until it is switched back.
panel.pbp_help: Splits the screen into two side-by-side video inputs
panel.pip_help: Overlays a small window from a second video input
panel.sub_input_help: Video input for the second window
panel.video_swap_help: Exchanges the main and sub-window inputs
panel.video_swap_tooltip: The monitor does not report which input is where, so the switch tracks the last swap made here.
panel.kvm_switch_help: Routes the keyboard and mouse to {output}
panel.kvm_tooltip: Experimental — switches the keyboard/mouse upstream between the monitor's video outputs. Only works while PIP/PBP is on. The monitor does not report the position, so the switch tracks the last position set here.
panel.pbp_note: PBP disables HDR and VRR on this monitor.
panel.pbp_off_note: PIP/PBP needs a second video source on another input.
panel.write_failed_detail: The monitor did not answer the DDC/CI request.
